text:
sara-partners: Starting marketplace onboarding for AWS/GCP/Azure. Need owners for infra, legal, packaging, GTM, and assets. Reply with ownership.
aj-devrel: I’ll own packaging + validation. Need hero images + a 1-liner by Wed.
kevin-legal: Legal will handle EULA + reseller clauses. I need the publisher contract template and any region-specific clauses.
vivian-product: I’ll own GTM copy and SKU mapping. Proposal: 14-day trial (time-limited) + metered usage. Thoughts?
liam-ops: Ops needs publisher IAM role ARN, staging bucket, and KMS key. I can provision staging in our infra account if approved.
marketplace-bot: Note: portal template v2 requires manifest_v3. Run `./scripts/publish_validate.sh --offer ./my_offer.tar.gz` to check.
aj-devrel: Packaging format: tar.gz with manifest.json at root, docs/, images/. Manifest must include "pricing" and a "trial_policy" field, e.g. "trial_policy": {"days": 14, "auto_charge": true} (manifest schema v3).
maria-marketing: I’ll review hero assets and write a short 3-bullet blurb. Send screenshots and logo SVG/PNG.
liam-ops: Provisioned staging: s3://rw-marketplace-staging-1724506789, iam role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/MarketplacePublisherStaging, kms alias alias/rw-marketplace-staging-kms. Lifecycle set to 30d.
kevin-legal: Heads up: Azure marketplace uses a slightly different indemnity clause; I’ll post a redline + checklist by EOD Tue.
sara-partners: Recap: AJ packaging/validation; Kevin legal; Liam ops (staging done); Vivian GTM+SKU; Maria assets. Target: submit to AWS/GCP/Azure portals Thu EOD. Any blockers?
aj-devrel: Running validation now against staging. Will share logs in thread.
marketplace-bot: Validation result: 0 errors, 1 warning (missing alt text for 800x418 hero).
vivian-product: I’ll add alt text and finalize SKU mapping tomorrow morning.
sara-partners: Thanks team. Scheduling quick sync 1pm tomorrow to finalize. :calendar:
